body.title: git_inspect: the read-only queries
body.summary: Add git_inspect (class none) with the read-only ops of the LLD (describe, name-rev, cherry, shortlog, show-branch, grep, last-modified, count-objects, var, version, check-attr, check-ignore, check-mailmap, check-ref-format, get-tar-commit-id, diff-files, diff-index, diff-pairs, range-diff, show-index, verify-commit, verify-tag, verify-pack, fsck, fsck-objects, pack-redundant, repo), each with its answer shape; a no-match exit gives a found false or an empty list. Mark each covered in the coverage table with a case through executeTool in a temporary repository. The no-assigned-row rule stays off until t9; this Task checks only its own rows.
acceptanceChecks: Every git_inspect op has a coverage case that runs through executeTool in a temporary repository and checks the result
A command that exits 1 to mean no match gives an empty answer, not a failure
No git_inspect op asks for approval
The coverage rows of these ops are covered, not assigned
